selection.rule: best native depth: J among coverage>=0.90 cells, tie-break fewer layers then the frozen R1 order; best fitted cell: J, then U, then fewer layers, then smaller gamma, then R1 order; both on development only

limits: Development rows on the 92 exposed dev scenes (4 engineering scenes excluded from every reported sample), 12 families; depth x arm x gamma are repeated measures on the same scenes and add no independent N. Intervals are descriptive family-bootstrap envelopes. Native transplantation reads scene-specific states and is an instrument, not a deployable map-free method. Nothing here is confirmation.
